settings.maxConcurrentHint: How many files encode at the same time; lower means a cooler, quieter machine
settings.webCodecHint: H.264 encodes faster; VP9 yields smaller files but is slower

settings.stripMetadataHint: Camera info, GPS location and other personal data are removed from outputs
